title: Tabletop Audio SoundPads
description: Native, in-Foundry recreation of the Tabletop Audio SoundPads: layered ambience, one-shots and music mixed live and broadcast to your players. Pad layouts are pre-cached as local data; audio streams from Tabletop Audio's CDN or an optional local copy. For personal use — support Tabletop Audio on Patreon.

tabletop-audio-soundpads.note: SoundPad descriptors live in packs/pads/*.json, generated offline by tools/scrape_pads.mjs.
